title: Issue page: draw the stall mark - StallPanel, the page wiring, the card badges
description:
The drawing half of HA-354, split out so the backend/lib half (PR #253) could be reviewed on its own. `lib/stall.ts` (markState, heldBy), `lib/attention.ts`'s resumeWords, the setStall/setHold client calls, and the Issue/IssueEventKind type changes are already merged (or in review) - this task is only the components and the page wiring on top of them.

## Scope

- `StallPanel.tsx` (new), copying `ClaimPanel.tsx`'s register: nothing at all when `markState(issue) === 'none'`; one line otherwise, composed from `markState`, `stalledWhy`, `resumeWords` and `heldBy`; presentational (no fetch, no error line, no busy state of its own). Two buttons, **Resume now** and **Hold for me**, gated on `directory?.me?.kind === 'person'` the way `ExpressControl` gates - a key reads the words and gets no buttons. **Hold for me** only in the `stalled` state, never in `held` (pressing it there would be a no-op write).
- `IssuePage.tsx`: render `<StallPanel>` directly after `<ClaimPanel>` and before `<ClearClaimDialog>` (the same slot `ClaimPanel` already sits in), wired to `setHold` through one `stallBusy` state and one `saveHold` callback, the same shape `saveExpress` already uses. `heldBy(events)` from the `events` the page already loads for `EventTrail` - no new fetch.
- `BoardCard.tsx`: two badges beside the asking one (`card.held` / `card.stalledAt`, held taking precedence so a row never shows both), distinct from the asking badge now that held/stalled are no longer questions.
- `App.css`: minimal classes for the panel and the two new badges, following `.hatch-claim` / `.hatch-card-asking`'s existing rules.

## Acceptance criteria

- An issue with no stall mark draws nothing extra on the issue page - no empty section, no heading.
- A stalled issue shows one line naming why (when there is a why) and when it resumes, with both buttons; a held issue shows one line (why, if any, and who held it) with only **Resume now**.
- A key reading the page sees the words and no buttons on either state.
- `BoardCard` shows a held or stalled badge, distinct from the asking badge, and never both at once on the same card.
- `make test-web` and lint green. The browser pass is the operator's.
